realm_description: Not a fixed place, but what Maruto becomes when civilization falls out of balance. Harai is temporary by nature — when balance returns, it transforms back into Maruto, a cycle called The Great Turning.

primary.label: Warden
primary.description: Guards boundaries that others don't even know exist; constant, thankless watch.
primary.guiding_promise: I will hold this line, long after everyone else has forgotten why it matters.
primary.shadow_description: Stands watch so long they start seeing threats at a threshold nothing is actually crossing.

secondary.label: Reformer
secondary.description: Driven by justice, dreads stagnation more than backlash.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will not accept a broken world when a better one is possible.
secondary.shadow_description: Burns down what was merely imperfect, mistaking any resistance for the enemy.

wheel.central_question: Should justice be weighed case by case, or upheld as an unbending line?

growth.label: Reformer
growth.description: Driven by justice, dreads stagnation more than backlash.
growth.guiding_promise: I will not accept a broken world when a better one is possible.
growth.shadow_description: Burns down what was merely imperfect, mistaking any resistance for the enemy.

other_ally.label: Custodian
other_ally.description: Refuses to let a tradition, language, or way of life slip away; care is not nostalgia but stubborn devotion.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will hold on to what matters, long after others have let it go.
trait_descriptions: Some things must not be lost.
other_ally.shadow_description: Guards the tradition so fiercely that nothing — not even necessary growth — is allowed through.

quarter.label: Navigator
quarter.description: Reads currents no one else notices; calculates the way through when the group panics.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will find the true course, even when the stars are hidden.
quarter.shadow_description: Trusts only their own reading of the current, and stops listening for anyone else's.

opposite.label: Judge
opposite.description: Weighs fairness deliberately; authority must be earned, not assumed.
opposite.guiding_promise: I hold the scale steady, even when the verdict costs me.
opposite.shadow_description: Hides behind the letter of the rule to avoid the harder, human work of mercy.

wheel.compatible_text: Reformer · Pathfinder — fellow travelers of The Broken Heart.
